visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and bangs is the central character, wearing a white t-shirt with a blue-and-beige sleeve detail. She stands in a brightly lit indoor room, holding a blue-and-black Nintendo Switch Joy-Con controller in her right hand, gesturing as she speaks with an expressive face. Behind her, a large television screen displays a colorful digital game menu featuring the title "The Last Campfire." The background is a simple, neutral-colored wall. White subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene transitions to 2D cartoon animation gameplay of "Home Sheep Home." Several white sheep characters with black faces are seen jumping across a variety of environments, including a desert with a large truck, a dark starry night with a radio tower, and an indoor mechanical setting. A yellow box at the top of the screen displays black text reading "NO.1 笑笑羊農場派對." The visual style is hand-drawn and whimsical, with labels like "P1" and "P2" floating above the characters to indicate players. (3) The footage switches to 3D animated gameplay from "It Takes Two," showcasing a little girl playing with two small dolls made of wood and yarn. The perspective shifts into the game world, showing the dolls navigating large-scale household and garden environments, such as a narrow wooden hallway and a garden with giant purple flowers. A split-screen view is used to show both characters' perspectives simultaneously. A yellow banner at the top reads "NO.2 雙人成行." A sentient, talking book with a mustache and a crown appears briefly. (4) The video displays 3D animated gameplay from "The Last Campfire." The main character is a small, blue, hooded figure with glowing white eyes traveling through a dark, atmospheric fantasy world filled with stone ruins, lush green forests, and glowing campfires. The character is shown climbing walls, crossing bridges, and interacting with large stone statues in a puzzle-filled environment. The lighting is moody and ethereal, with soft blue and green hues. A yellow text box at the top states "NO.3 the last campfire 最後的營火." (5) The camera returns to live-action, showing the woman sitting on a gray fabric sofa. She holds a pink Kirby plush toy and a black controller, pointing her finger upward to emphasize a point. She is later joined by a young boy with short black hair wearing a green tank top, who sits next to her while holding a blue Switch controller. They both look into the camera and laugh, creating a warm, domestic atmosphere. Yellow variety-show style text and white subtitles appear on the screen during their interaction.
